ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, which animal is a secondary consumer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: at the bottom of the figure are Meadow Grasses; above them are Deer, Rabbit, and Vole; at the top are Coyote and Hawk. Arrows point from Meadow Grasses to Deer, Rabbit, and Vole, indicating that these animals eat grass; there is also an arrow in the figure from Rabbit to Coyote, indicating that Coyote eats Rabbit. Then reason: Meadow Grasses are producers, and Rabbit eats grass so it is a primary consumer; Coyote eats Rabbit, this primary consumer, so Coyote is a secondary consumer.
